name: Plesiosaurus
description: A canoe-length marine lizard that has a long neck and four flippers.

abilities.name: Only a Rumor
abilities.description: While deep underwater, the Plesiosaurus can’t be located or targeted.

abilities.name: Wall of Water
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to have the Plesiosaurus breach and crash, sending a wall of water from one side of its body. Each PC within Far range on that side of the Plesiosaurus must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (18) or take 3d10 physical damage and be pushed back to Far range.
